table|tokens|tokens|CREATE TABLE "tokens"(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,issued_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,revoked_at INTEGER,name TEXT,kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cli' CONSTRAINT token_kind CHECK(kind IN('cli','session','service')),scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'write' CONSTRAINT token_scope CHECK(scope IN('read','write')),expires_at INTEGER,idle_ms INTEGER CONSTRAINT token_idle CHECK(idle_ms IS NULL OR idle_ms > 0),last_used_at INTEGER,last_ip TEXT,parent_id TEXT REFERENCES tokens(id))STRICT
table|tool_calls|tool_calls|CREATE TABLE tool_calls(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),node_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id),role TEXT NOT NULL,round INTEGER NOT NULL,tool TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT,started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,exit_code INTEGER,ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ok IN(0,1)),proc_pid INTEGER)STRICT
table|usage_ledger|usage_ledger|CREATE TABLE "usage_ledger"(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),node_id TEXT REFERENCES nodes(id),role TEXT NOT NULL,model_tier TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(model_tier IN('light','standard','heavy')),provider TEXT NOT NULL,model_id TEXT NOT NULL,upstream TEXT,input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_read_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,cache_write_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,reasoning_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,micro_usd INTEGER NOT NULL,billing TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(billing IN('computed','reported')),billing_fallback INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,ts INTEGER NOT NULL,proc_kind TEXT,proc_pid INTEGER,payer_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id),payer_scope TEXT CONSTRAINT payer_scope_enum CHECK(payer_scope IS NULL OR payer_scope IN('user','project')),started_at INTEGER,duration_ms INTEGER,attempts INTEGER)STRICT
table|user_channels|user_channels|CREATE TABLE "user_channels"(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(channel IN('ws','ntfy','lark','dingtalk','wecom','email')),target TEXT NOT NULL,priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)STRICT
table|users|users|CREATE TABLE "users"(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,display_name TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN('lead','member','observer')),domain_tags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,disabled_at INTEGER,lang TEXT CHECK(lang IS NULL OR lang IN('zh','en')),kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'human' CONSTRAINT user_kind CHECK(kind IN('human','service')),budget_usd_month INTEGER CONSTRAINT user_budget CHECK(budget_usd_month IS NULL OR budget_usd_month >= 0),github_login TEXT CHECK(github_login IS NULL OR(length(github_login)BETWEEN 1 AND 39 AND github_login NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9-]*')),commit_email TEXT CHECK(commit_email IS NULL OR(instr(commit_email,'@')> 1 AND length(commit_email)<= 254)),github_id INTEGER CHECK(github_id IS NULL OR github_id > 0),tz TEXT CHECK(tz IS NULL OR length(tz)BETWEEN 1 AND 64),CONSTRAINT domain_tags_json CHECK("domain_tags" IS NULL OR CASE WHEN json_valid("domain_tags")THEN json_type("domain_tags")= 'array' ELSE 0 END))STRICT
trigger|trg_assumptions_no_delete|assumptions|CREATE TRIGGER trg_assumptions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON assumptions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'assumptions: supersede instead of delete'); END
trigger|trg_audit_no_delete|audit_log|CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'audit_log is append-only'); END
trigger|trg_audit_no_update|audit_log|CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'audit_log is append-only'); END
trigger|trg_decision_registry_transition|decision_registry|CREATE TRIGGER trg_decision_registry_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON decision_registry WHEN NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND(OLD.status || '>' || NEW.status)NOT IN('active>void')BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'decision_registry: illegal status transition'); END
trigger|trg_decisions_no_delete|decisions|CREATE TRIGGER trg_decisions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON decisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'decisions: supersede instead of delete'); END
trigger|trg_edges_no_delete|edges|CREATE TRIGGER trg_edges_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON edges BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'edges: append-only,supersede instead of delete'); END
trigger|trg_edges_supersede_only|edges|CREATE TRIGGER trg_edges_supersede_only BEFORE UPDATE ON edges WHEN NOT(OLD.superseded_at IS NULL AND NEW.superseded_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.from_id IS OLD.from_id AND NEW.to_id IS OLD.to_id AND NEW.relation IS OLD.relation AND NEW.valid_from IS OLD.valid_from AND NEW.recorded_at IS OLD.recorded_at AND(OLD.valid_to IS NULL OR NEW.valid_to IS OLD.valid_to))BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'edges: append-only,only superseded_at/valid_to may be set once'); END
trigger|trg_handover_requests_transition|handover_requests|CREATE TRIGGER trg_handover_requests_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON handover_requests WHEN NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND(OLD.status || '>' || NEW.status)NOT IN('open>approved','open>rejected','open>withdrawn')BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'handover_requests: illegal status transition'); END
trigger|trg_messages_no_delete|messages|CREATE TRIGGER trg_messages_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON messages BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'messages are immutable'); END
trigger|trg_node_done_requires_handoff|nodes|CREATE TRIGGER trg_node_done_requires_handoff BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON nodes WHEN NEW.status = 'done' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM handoffs h WHERE h.node_id = NEW.id AND h.validated_at IS NOT NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'node cannot be done without a validated handoff record'); END
trigger|trg_node_insert_done_requires_handoff|nodes|CREATE TRIGGER trg_node_insert_done_requires_handoff BEFORE INSERT ON nodes WHEN NEW.status = 'done' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM handoffs h WHERE h.node_id = NEW.id AND h.validated_at IS NOT NULL)BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'node cannot be inserted as done without a validated handoff record'); END
trigger|trg_nodes_transition|nodes|CREATE TRIGGER trg_nodes_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON nodes WHEN NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND(OLD.status || '>' || NEW.status)NOT IN('pending>ready','pending>running','pending>blocked','pending>review','pending>done','pending>void','pending>failed','ready>pending','ready>running','ready>blocked','ready>review','ready>done','ready>void','ready>failed','running>pending','running>blocked','running>review','running>done','running>void','running>failed','blocked>pending','blocked>ready','blocked>running','blocked>void','blocked>failed','review>pending','review>running','review>done','review>void','review>failed','done>pending','done>void','failed>pending','failed>void')BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'nodes: illegal status transition'); END
trigger|trg_params_no_delete|params|CREATE TRIGGER trg_params_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON params BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'params: supersede instead of delete'); END
trigger|trg_projects_transition|projects|CREATE TRIGGER trg_projects_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON projects WHEN NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND(OLD.status || '>' || NEW.status)NOT IN('proposed>active','proposed>done','proposed>aborted','active>proposed','active>done','active>stalled','active>aborted','stalled>active','stalled>done','stalled>aborted','done>active','done>stalled','done>aborted','aborted>proposed','aborted>active')BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'projects: illegal status transition'); END
trigger|trg_questions_transition|questions|CREATE TRIGGER trg_questions_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON questions WHEN NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND(OLD.status || '>' || NEW.status)NOT IN('open>escalated','open>answered','open>defaulted','open>withdrawn','escalated>answered','escalated>defaulted','escalated>withdrawn')BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'questions: illegal status transition'); END
trigger|trg_revisions_transition|revisions|CREATE TRIGGER trg_revisions_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON revisions WHEN NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND(OLD.status || '>' || NEW.status)NOT IN('proposed>applied','proposed>rejected')BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'revisions: illegal status transition'); END
trigger|trg_tasks_transition|tasks|CREATE TRIGGER trg_tasks_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON tasks WHEN NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND(OLD.status || '>' || NEW.status)NOT IN('planning>running','planning>waiting','planning>suspended','planning>done','planning>aborted','running>planning','running>waiting','running>suspended','running>done','running>aborted','waiting>planning','waiting>running','waiting>suspended','waiting>done','waiting>aborted','suspended>planning','suspended>running','suspended>waiting','suspended>aborted','done>planning','done>running','done>waiting','done>suspended','done>aborted','aborted>planning','aborted>running','aborted>waiting','aborted>suspended')BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'tasks: illegal status transition'); END
trigger|trg_usage_no_delete|usage_ledger|CREATE TRIGGER trg_usage_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON usage_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'usage_ledger is append-only'); END
trigger|trg_usage_no_update|usage_ledger|CREATE TRIGGER trg_usage_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON usage_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'usage_ledger is append-only'); END
